name: Kona
description: Designed for life on the move, the Kona delivers the versatility parents expect from an everyday stroller in a lighter, more nimble footprint. A lightning-fast one-hand fold in either seat direction and a slim frame make transitions effortless, from subway stairs to sidewalk strolls. Kona is ready from birth and built to keep up without compromise. Because when life moves fast, your stroller should too.
